title: P15.9-B5.5 R2: restore canonical cost policy governance fields (period + hard_stop)
description: R2 minimal closure on PR #101. R2-F1 — the R1 cost policy remapping dropped hard_stop and never showed period; both are canonical governance fields in src/pair/cost.ts (period ∈ DAY/WEEK/MONTH/MISSION_LIFETIME; hard_stop boolean controls whether excess blocks dispatch). The policies table now renders a Period column verbatim and a Hard stop column that only maps strict boolean true→'yes' / false→'no'; missing or noncanonical values render 'unknown' and are never inferred from enabled/status/warning_threshold_pct/max_microusd. All accepted R1 behavior is preserved: max_microusd limit, business_id/scope_type/scope_id triple, integer-safe usd() (null/string/noncanonical → 'unknown', never $0), and the canonical profile pricing fields. Strictly read-only — zero cost mutations. E2E: the R1-F1 fixture was rewritten to canonical contract values (scope_type business/department/agent/mission, period DAY/WEEK/MONTH/MISSION_LIFETIME, billing_mode METERED_API/SUBSCRIPTION) and asserts: two equal $2.5 limits with hard_stop true vs false stay distinguishable, DAY vs MONTH vs MISSION_LIFETIME are visibly distinct, missing/string hard_stop renders 'unknown' (never yes/no), string/null amounts never $0, reserve 0 is a real $0, and a mutation counter registered ahead of the read fulfillers proves zero non-GET calls to /api/cost*. Accepted theme (F2) and credential/SSE (F3) fixes untouched. UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
